static_traits.name: Emily Baxter
static_traits.social_status: Relationship tension with the boss, Work performance affected by Self-doubt; tending to withdraw in Social situations; family supportive but not yet opening up to talk about feelings with family
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no prior psychotherapy experience; never had similar psychological problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good organization; highly cooperative; moderately Anxious tone; harsh self-evaluation, often using 'should' phrasing; overall Neutral attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling incapable and low in self-worth when facing situations lacking knowledge or awareness; it all started when I discovered I did not know Bob Marley, triggering strong self-criticism. I now persistently doubt my intelligence and feel insecure about my knowledge.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of incapability and low self-worth are affecting my daily life and interactions with others, including Work performance and the relationship with my boss.

core_beliefs: If I do not know common knowledge or information, it means I am not smart enough / not competent
I must know something about everything to count as smart and worthy of recognition

special_situations.event: When Bob Marley was mentioned while chatting with friends, I said I did not know him, the other's reaction made me feel treated as an 'idiot'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not know a widely-known person or knowledge, it proves I am stupid
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterwards doubling self-study and proactively making up lessons to avoid embarrassment again

special_situations.event: Encountering unfamiliar information or problems at Work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should know everything about all things, otherwise I am not smart enough / not competent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-preparation at Work, speaking cautiously, trying to make up for knowledge gaps
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not smart enough, unable to handle the manager's Work

special_situations.event: When communicating with the boss or receiving evaluation feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I show areas I do not understand, the boss will think my ability is poor
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing communication, avoiding exposing the 'not knowing' parts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He will look down on me / I disappointed him

special_situations.event: Worrying about encountering topics one does not know in social conversation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If ignorance is exposed again, I will be laughed at, looked down on
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids conversations; withdraws from dialogue to prevent embarrassment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am stupid; the scene will be very awkward

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as smart and competent, recognized and accepted by others
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being humiliated, looked down on, judged as stupid and incapable
defense_goal: Through self-criticism and withdrawal, avoids judgment and shame
Reducing exposure to 'not knowing' situations to maintain security
Controlling the Unknown and uncertainty through doubled Learning

object_relations.self_representation: An avoider who needs support but dares not speak up
object_relations.object_representation: Family members who may look down on me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others focus on one's 'not knowing' content, asking questions or waiting for answers in conversation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to understand others' attention as judgment or contempt (Projecting the image of friends/boss onto current interaction partners)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use a supportive and normalizing tone, avoiding judgment; inviting evidence through reality testing and open-ended Questioning, first Empathizing with shame then doing cognitive restructuring.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about experiences of exposing 'not knowing' in social settings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes others will treat them like a friend did, as an 'idiot', and thus distance or humiliate them
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gently pointing out the cost of self-reproach, inviting identification of self-critical statements, use restatement and boundary Clarification, encouraging self-compassion.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about expressing feelings to family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying family will look down on oneself and thus unwilling to express, tending to suppress feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a tone of safe exploration and stepwise exposure, inviting them to name the emotional intensity, allowing privacy to be retained and providing alternative expression methods (writing, segmented sharing).

manifestations: Retreats in social conversation for fear of embarrassment
Not yet opening up to family about feelings, worrying about being looked down on
Constraining self with the external standard of 'I should know everything' (Introjection)
Ties self-worth to omniscience and others' evaluations
outcomes: Avoidance shrinking the space of options

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Believes 'to be considered smart one must know everything'

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Avoiding or retreating from social conversations, avoiding facing Unknown topics
Reduces communication with others to escape possible embarrassment

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing friends/boss will look down on oneself
Assuming others will humiliate or look down on oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Being overly cautious for fear of poor performance, affecting Work and communication

positive_force: Has a supportive family (can seek help and guidance)
Has practical ability and experience in restaurant management and client communication
Willing to self-educate and learn to improve knowledge
Able to identify and describe one's own problems and trigger situations (self-awareness)
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external evaluation to determine self-worth (External Validation)
Self-evaluation marked by overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking
Mind-reading and negative prediction leading to Social avoidance

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecation / inner abuse ('I am an idiot')
antecedent: Exposing unknown common knowledge in conversation with friends (such as Bob Marley)
Facing unfamiliar information or knowledge gaps
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one knowledge gap into overall insufficient ability, and Self-denying and self-punishing with the Introjected standard of 'should know everything'
target_behavior.function: Vents shame through self-punishment and tries to preempt external criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening Anxiety and low self-worth, affecting Work performance and interpersonal interaction

antecedent: Social situations where one worries about encountering topics one does not know
When communicating with the boss or receiving feedback, fears being judged
target_behavior.core_reason: Afraid of embarrassment and being looked down on (negative prediction and mind reading)
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential shame and judgment to gain a short-term sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal alienation, Relationship tension with the boss, hindered professional communication

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive Self-doubt at Work leading to declining performance
antecedent: Encountering unfamiliar problems when performing management tasks
Receiving or Anticipating feedback from the boss
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one social embarrassment into one's own incapability, and persistently Self-denying
target_behavior.function: Avoiding taking risks and responsibilities to ease Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Declining performance, hindered Career development, further tense relationship with the boss
